tie_reference: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: TIE.
source_note: Verified Basic Mathematics Form One lesson plans (Arusha Catholic Seminary). 30 lesson plans (80 min double periods, 2 per week) covering Term I (Concept of Mathematics, Numbers Classification, Real Numbers and Inequalities, Absolute Value, Approximation & Rounding, Significant Figures) and Term II (Ratios, Proportions, Algebraic Expressions, Linear Equations, Simultaneous Equations, Inequalities, Coordinate Geometry: Cartesian Plane, Gradient, Equation of Straight Line, Graphing Linear Equations).

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 1: MEANING AND BRANCHES OF MATHEMATICS
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of foundational mathematical concepts
lessons.specific_competence: 1.1 Explain the meaning and branches of Mathematics
lessons.main_activity: Explain the meaning and branches of Mathematics
lessons.specific_activity: Define Mathematics; classify its branches (Arithmetic, Algebra, Geometry, Statistics) with examples of what each branch studies
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners where they used numbers or shapes on their way to school.
Defines Mathematics; introduces the four branches with the classification chart and one example problem per branch.
Guides a concept-mapping activity where groups sort given problems (e.g. "measuring a plot," "solving for x," "average rainfall") under the correct branch.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Build concept map in groups matching problems to branches.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses oral questions asking learners to justify their group's placements.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 2: RELATE MATHEMATICS TO OTHER SUBJECTS AND EXPLAIN ITS IMPORTANCE
lessons.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of foundational mathematical concepts
lessons.specific_competence: 1.1 Relate Mathematics to other subjects and explain its importance
lessons.main_activity: Explain the relationship between Mathematics and other subjects and its importance
lessons.specific_activity: Relate Mathematics to Science, Economics, and Geography; discuss the importance of Mathematics in daily life and in careers
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps the four branches; asks how a shopkeeper uses Mathematics daily.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Recall previous lesson; give an example.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Explains links between Mathematics and Science, Economics, and Geography with concrete examples of each.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct identification of at least 2 links

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Assigns groups a career flashcard (engineer, accountant, pilot, nurse) to prepare a short case study on how that career uses Mathematics.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Discuss in groups; prepare and present a case study.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Facilitates discussion comparing presentations; administers the Chapter 1 Review Test.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Listen to peers; complete review test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 3: CLASSIFY NATURAL NUMBERS, WHOLE NUMBERS, AND INTEGERS
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the number system
lessons.specific_competence: 2.1 Classify natural numbers, whole numbers, and integers
lessons.main_activity: Explain the concept of numbers and their basic classifications
lessons.specific_activity: Define a number; classify natural numbers, whole numbers, and integers with examples on a number line
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners to list any five numbers they use in a typical day.
Defines natural numbers, whole numbers, and integers, showing each set on the number line.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes; plot examples on number line.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides a number classification sorting activity where groups place number cards into the correct set (natural/whole/integer).
Checks notebooks and asks oral questions on the three sets.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 4: DEFINE AND CLASSIFY RATIONAL AND IRRATIONAL NUMBERS
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the number system
lessons.specific_competence: 2.1 Define and classify rational and irrational numbers
lessons.main_activity: Explain rational and irrational numbers
lessons.specific_activity: Define rational numbers with examples (fractions, terminating/recurring decimals); define irrational numbers with examples (√2, π)
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps natural/whole/integer numbers; asks if ½ fits any of those sets.
Defines rational numbers (fractions, terminating/recurring decimals) and irrational numbers (√2, π) with worked examples.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes; try converting fractions to decimals.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pair work sorting a mixed list of numbers into rational and irrational categories, justifying each choice.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Sort numbers in pairs; justify classification.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers a short classification test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 5: EXPLAIN THE REAL NUMBER SYSTEM
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the number system
lessons.main_activity: Describe the real number system
lessons.specific_activity: Describe the real number system as the union of rational and irrational numbers; place a variety of numbers correctly within the real number system diagram
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners to recall rational and irrational numbers from the previous lesson.
Explains the real number system as the union of rational and irrational numbers using a Venn-style diagram.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct description of the real number system

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pair work placing a list of mixed numbers correctly onto the real number system diagram.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Place numbers on diagram in pairs.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses oral questions confirming understanding of the real number system.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 6: REPRESENT INEQUALITIES IN REAL NUMBERS
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the number system
lessons.main_activity: Represent and solve simple inequalities on a number line
lessons.specific_activity: Represent and solve simple inequalities using <, >, ≤, ≥ on a number line
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners to compare their heights using "greater than" or "less than."
Introduces the symbols <, >, ≤, ≥ and demonstrates representing simple inequalities on a number line.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Take notes; copy number line examples.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pair work solving and representing a set of inequality statements on the number line.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Work in pairs on inequality problems.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers a short quiz on inequalities.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 7: DEFINE AND DETERMINE THE ABSOLUTE VALUE OF A REAL NUMBER
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the number system
lessons.specific_competence: 2.3 Define and determine the absolute value of a real number
lessons.main_activity: Explain the meaning of absolute value
lessons.specific_activity: Define absolute value as distance from zero; calculate |x| for a range of positive and negative real numbers
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks how far -5 and 5 are from zero on a number line.
Defines absolute value as distance from zero; works through examples calculating |x| for various numbers on the board.
Guides pair practice calculating absolute values using the number-line distance illustration for a worksheet of numbers.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Solve problems in pairs using number line.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses oral questions reviewing the definition and calculation method.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 8: SOLVE PROBLEMS INVOLVING ABSOLUTE VALUE
lessons.main_competence: 2.0 Demonstrate mastery of the number system
lessons.main_activity: Apply absolute value to solve simple problems
lessons.specific_activity: Solve simple word and equation problems involving absolute value; consolidate the full number system (natural, whole, integer, rational, irrational, real, absolute value)
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps absolute value calculation briefly with a quick example.
Demonstrates solving simple equations/word problems involving absolute value step by step.
Guides pair problem-solving on a worksheet combining absolute value with the full number classification learned across the chapter.
Administers the Chapter 2 Review Test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 9: EXPLAIN THE MEANING OF APPROXIMATION
lessons.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of approximation techniques
lessons.main_activity: Explain the meaning and purpose of approximation
lessons.specific_activity: Define approximation; explain why and when estimation is used in daily life
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners to estimate the total cost of items in a shopping basket without a calculator.
Defines approximation; discusses everyday situations requiring estimation (shopping, time, distance).
Guides a discussion activity where groups estimate answers to given real-life scenario cards before calculating exactly.
Poses oral questions on when approximation is appropriate.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 10: ROUND OFF NUMBERS
lessons.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of approximation techniques
lessons.main_activity: Round off numbers to given place values
lessons.specific_activity: Round off numbers to the nearest whole number, tens, hundreds, and decimal places
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps why estimation matters; asks learners to round 47 to the nearest ten mentally.
Demonstrates rounding rules for whole numbers, tens, hundreds, and decimal places with worked examples.
Guides rounding drills in pairs across a range of place values.
Poses oral questions reviewing rounding rules.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 11: DETERMINE SIGNIFICANT FIGURES
lessons.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of approximation techniques
lessons.main_activity: State and apply rules for significant figures
lessons.specific_activity: State the rules for significant figures; round numbers to a given number of significant figures
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks why "300" might mean different levels of precision.
States and explains the rules for identifying significant figures with worked examples.
Guides pair drills rounding numbers to a specified number of significant figures.
Administers the Significant Figures Test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 12: APPLY APPROXIMATIONS IN CALCULATIONS
lessons.main_competence: 3.0 Demonstrate mastery of approximation techniques
lessons.main_activity: Apply approximation in everyday estimation and calculations
lessons.specific_activity: Apply rounding and significant figures to solve real-life estimation problems (shopping totals, measurements, distances)
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps significant figures briefly with a rapid example.
Demonstrates applying approximation to solve a multi-step real-life estimation problem.
Guides groups through real-life estimation task cards requiring rounding and significant figures.
Administers the Chapter 3 Review Test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 13: DEFINE AND EXPRESS RATIOS
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of ratios and proportions
lessons.main_activity: Explain the concept of ratio
lessons.specific_activity: Define ratio; express given quantities as ratios; simplify ratios to their lowest terms
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks how learners would fairly share 12 sweets between 3 friends.
Defines ratio; demonstrates expressing quantities as ratios and simplifying them using counters.
Guides group practice expressing and simplifying a variety of quantity comparisons as ratios.
Poses oral questions reviewing ratio simplification.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 14: APPLY RATIOS TO REAL-LIFE SHARING PROBLEMS
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of ratios and proportions
lessons.specific_competence: 4.1 Apply ratios to real-life sharing problems
lessons.main_activity: Apply ratios to solve real-life sharing problems
lessons.specific_activity: Solve real-life problems involving sharing a quantity according to a given ratio
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps simplifying ratios briefly with a quick example.
Demonstrates solving a real-life sharing problem step by step using a given ratio.
Guides group activity solving several real-life sharing problems (money, land, ingredients) using ratios.
Poses oral questions consolidating the topic.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 15: EXPLAIN DIRECT PROPORTION
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of ratios and proportions
lessons.main_activity: Explain and solve problems involving direct proportion
lessons.specific_activity: Define direct proportion; solve problems where two quantities increase or decrease together (e.g. recipes, cost per item)
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks how the cost of sugar changes if you buy double the amount.
Defines direct proportion; works through recipe/cost examples showing quantities increasing together.
Guides pair work solving direct proportion problems from real-life scenarios (recipes, shopping).
Poses oral questions reviewing direct proportion.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 16: EXPLAIN INVERSE PROPORTION
lessons.main_competence: 4.0 Demonstrate mastery of ratios and proportions
lessons.main_activity: Explain and solve problems involving inverse proportion
lessons.specific_activity: Define inverse proportion; solve problems where one quantity increases as another decreases (e.g. speed/time, workers/days)
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks how travel time changes if speed doubles over the same distance.
Defines inverse proportion; works through speed/time and workers/days examples.
Guides pair work solving inverse proportion problems and comparing them with direct proportion problems from Period 1.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Solve problems in pairs; compare with direct proportion cases.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers the Chapter 4 Review Test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 17: FORM ALGEBRAIC EXPRESSIONS
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.main_activity: Define algebraic terms and form expressions from word statements
lessons.specific_activity: Define algebraic expression, term, coefficient, and variable; form expressions from given word statements
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners to represent "a number plus 3" symbolically.
Defines expression, term, coefficient, and variable with guided examples on the board.
Guides pair work matching given word problems to their correct algebraic expressions.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Match word problems to expressions in pairs.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses oral questions reviewing key terms.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 18: SIMPLIFY ALGEBRAIC EXPRESSIONS
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.main_activity: Simplify algebraic expressions by collecting like terms
lessons.specific_activity: Identify like and unlike terms; simplify expressions by collecting like terms
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps forming expressions; asks if 3x and 5x can be combined.
Explains identifying like terms and demonstrates simplification step by step.
Guides pair practice simplifying a worksheet of expressions by collecting like terms.
Administers a short quiz on simplification.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 19: FORM LINEAR EQUATIONS FROM WORD PROBLEMS
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.specific_competence: 5.2 Form linear equations from word problems
lessons.main_activity: Form linear equations from word problems
lessons.specific_activity: Translate word problems into linear equations in one unknown
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses a simple word problem requiring an unknown number ("I think of a number, add 5, I get 12").
Demonstrates translating word problems into algebraic equations step by step.
Guides pair practice forming equations from a set of word problems.
Poses oral questions reviewing the translation process.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 20: SOLVE LINEAR EQUATIONS
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.main_activity: Solve linear equations in one unknown
lessons.specific_activity: Solve linear equations in one unknown using inverse operations
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps forming equations; presents one formed in Period 1 to solve.
Demonstrates solving linear equations step by step using inverse operations.
Guides pair problem-solving on a worksheet of linear equations, including those formed from word problems.
Administers a short quiz.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 21: SOLVE SIMULTANEOUS EQUATIONS BY ELIMINATION
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.main_activity: Solve linear simultaneous equations using the elimination method
lessons.specific_activity: Solve simultaneous equations in two unknowns using the elimination method
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses a problem involving two unknowns (e.g. two numbers' sum and difference).
Demonstrates the elimination method step by step on the board.
Guides pair practice solving simultaneous equations using elimination.
Poses oral questions checking understanding of each elimination step.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 22: SOLVE SIMULTANEOUS EQUATIONS BY SUBSTITUTION
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.main_activity: Solve linear simultaneous equations using the substitution method
lessons.specific_activity: Solve simultaneous equations in two unknowns using the substitution method; compare with the elimination method
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps elimination method briefly; asks if there's another way to solve the same equations.
Demonstrates the substitution method step by step, then compares it with elimination.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Follow demonstration; take notes on both methods.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pair practice solving a mixed set of simultaneous equations, choosing either method.
Administers a written test covering both methods.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 23: SOLVE LINEAR INEQUALITIES WITH ONE UNKNOWN
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.specific_competence: 5.4 Solve linear inequalities with one unknown
lessons.main_activity: Solve simple linear inequalities
lessons.specific_activity: Solve simple inequalities in one unknown using inverse operations, noting the effect of multiplying/dividing by a negative number
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners for numbers that satisfy "x is greater than 3."
Demonstrates solving simple inequalities step by step, highlighting the sign-flip rule when dividing by a negative.
Guides pair practice solving a worksheet of inequalities.
Poses oral questions reviewing the sign-flip rule.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 24: REPRESENT INEQUALITY SOLUTIONS ON A NUMBER LINE
lessons.main_competence: 5.0 Demonstrate mastery of algebraic manipulation and equations
lessons.specific_competence: 5.4 Represent inequality solutions on a number line
lessons.main_activity: Represent solutions of inequalities on a number line
lessons.specific_activity: Represent solution sets of linear inequalities on a number line, distinguishing open and closed circles
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps solving inequalities; asks how to show "x > 3" on a number line.
Demonstrates representing solutions on a number line, explaining open circles (<, >) vs closed circles (≤, ≥).
Guides pair practice solving inequalities and representing each solution on a number line.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Solve and represent solutions in pairs.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers the Chapter 5 Review Test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 25: DESCRIBE THE CARTESIAN PLANE AND PLOT POINTS
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry
lessons.specific_competence: 6.1 Describe the Cartesian plane and plot points
lessons.main_activity: Explain the Cartesian plane and plot points
lessons.specific_activity: Describe the Cartesian plane, axes, and origin; plot given points accurately on graph paper
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners how to describe a seat position in a classroom grid (row and column).
Introduces the Cartesian plane, x- and y-axes, and origin; demonstrates plotting points.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct description of the Cartesian plane

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pair practice plotting a set of given coordinate points on graph paper.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Plot points in pairs on graph paper.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses oral questions on reading coordinates from plotted points.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 26: DETERMINE THE GRADIENT OF A STRAIGHT LINE
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry
lessons.specific_competence: 6.1 Determine the gradient of a straight line
lessons.main_activity: Calculate the gradient of a line joining two points
lessons.specific_activity: Calculate the gradient of a straight line joining two given points using the gradient formula
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps plotting points; asks which of two plotted lines looks "steeper."
Introduces the gradient formula and demonstrates calculating gradient between two points.
Guides pair practice calculating gradients for several pairs of points on graph paper.
Administers a gradient calculation test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 27: DERIVE THE EQUATION OF A STRAIGHT LINE
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry
lessons.specific_competence: 6.2 Derive the equation of a straight line
lessons.main_activity: Derive the equation of a straight line in the form y = mx + c
lessons.specific_activity: Derive the equation of a line given its gradient and y-intercept, and given two points, in the form y = mx + c
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Reviews gradient calculation from the previous week briefly.
Derives the equation y = mx + c using guided steps, showing how gradient and intercept build the equation.
Guides pair practice deriving equations of lines from given gradient/intercept and from two points.
Poses oral questions reviewing the derivation steps.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 28: EXPRESS THE GENERAL EQUATION OF A STRAIGHT LINE
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry
lessons.specific_competence: 6.2 Express the general equation of a straight line
lessons.main_activity: Express equations in general form ax + by + c = 0
lessons.specific_activity: Convert equations between the form y = mx + c and the general form ax + by + c = 0
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps y = mx + c briefly; shows an equation and asks learners to identify m and c.
Demonstrates converting y = mx + c into general form ax + by + c = 0 and vice versa.
Guides pair practice converting a set of equations between the two forms.
Administers a written test.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 29: GRAPH LINEAR EQUATIONS USING A TABLE OF VALUES
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry
lessons.specific_competence: 6.3 Graph linear equations using a table of values
lessons.main_activity: Draw graphs of linear equations
lessons.specific_activity: Construct a table of values for a linear equation and draw its graph on graph paper
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Asks learners how many points are needed to draw a straight line.
Demonstrates constructing a table of values and plotting the resulting line graph.
teaching_structure.assessment_criteria: Correct construction of table of values

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Guides pair practice constructing tables and drawing graphs for a set of given linear equations.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Draw graphs in pairs using rulers.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Poses oral questions on reading values from the graphs drawn.

lessons.title: MATHEMATICS FORM ONE LESSON PLAN NO. 30: SOLVE SIMULTANEOUS EQUATIONS GRAPHICALLY
lessons.main_competence: 6.0 Demonstrate mastery of coordinate geometry
lessons.main_activity: Solve simultaneous equations by finding the point of intersection of two graphs
lessons.specific_activity: Draw two linear equations on the same axes and identify the point of intersection as the solution to the simultaneous equations
lessons.references: TIE (2026). Mathematics for Secondary Schools Student's Book Form 1. Dar es Salaam: Tanzania Institute of Education.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Recaps drawing a single line graph; asks what it means if two lines cross.
Demonstrates drawing two linear equations on the same axes and reading off the intersection point as the solution.
Guides pair drawing of two graphs for a given pair of simultaneous equations, verifying the solution algebraically.
teaching_structure.learning_activities: Draw graphs; verify solution in pairs.

teaching_structure.teaching_activities: Administers the Chapter 6 Review Test.
